phenomena.claim: Cosmological expansion: a redshift-distance relation among galaxies
phenomena.source: Hubble, PNAS 15, 168-173 (1929), doi:10.1073/pnas.15.3.168 -- reference verified via PNAS listing + INSPIRE 2026-09-23; archive: REALITY_PICTURE_01 LEVEL 0 item 8 [E]
phenomena.caveat: Hubble's 1929 distance calibration was badly off in absolute scale; the relation itself is the observed content

phenomena.claim: Accelerating expansion from Type Ia supernova distances
phenomena.source: Riess et al., AJ 116, 1009-1038 (1998) (high-z SNe 10-15% farther than expected, positive cosmological constant); Perlmutter et al., ApJ 517, 565-586 (1999) (42 SNe, P(Lambda>0)=99%, flat-universe Omega_m ~ 0.28) -- both abstract-verified 2026-09-23; archive: REALITY_PICTURE_01 LEVEL 0 item 8 [E]
phenomena.caveat: acceleration is inferred through the FLRW distance framework; within that framework it is multiply confirmed (BAO, CMB)

phenomena.claim: The cosmic microwave background: an isotropic radiation field with a near-perfect blackbody spectrum
phenomena.source: Penzias & Wilson, ApJ 142, 419-421 (1965), doi:10.1086/148307 (discovery, ~3.5 K excess antenna temperature -- reference verified via ADS/journal listings 2026-09-23); Fixsen et al., ApJ 473, 576 (1996) (COBE/FIRAS: RMS spectral deviations < 50 ppm of peak, |y| < 15e-6, |mu| < 9e-5) -- abstract-verified 2026-09-23; archive: REALITY_PICTURE_01 LEVEL 0 item 8 [E]

phenomena.claim: BBN-CMB baryon concordance: the baryon density inferred from the primordial deuterium abundance agrees with the independently CMB-derived value -- a PREDICTION-grade confirmation that preceded measurement and could have failed
phenomena.source: Cooke, Pettini & Steidel, ApJ 855, 102 (2018), arXiv:1710.11129 ((D/H)_P = (2.527 +/- 0.030)e-5; BBN baryon density within 2 sigma of Planck); Fields, Olive, Yeh & Young, JCAP 03 (2020) 010, arXiv:1912.01132 (BBN after Planck) -- both abstract-verified 2026-09-23; archive: RAI_STRUCTURAL_THEORY_SEARCH Answer 1, 'PREDICTION-grade confirmations that preceded measurement and could have failed -- BBN<->CMB baryon concordance'
phenomena.caveat: the lithium problem remains at the abundance level and 'is more acute given the very tight D/H observational constraints' (Fields et al. 2020); the concordance statement rests on D/H + CMB

phenomena.claim: Large-scale structure with the baryon acoustic oscillation feature imprinted at the sound-horizon scale
phenomena.source: Eisenstein et al., ApJ 633, 560-574 (2005), astro-ph/0501171 (BAO peak at 100 h^-1 Mpc in SDSS LRG correlation function); DESI Collaboration, 'DESI 2024 VI', arXiv:2404.03002, JCAP (>6M objects, 0.1<z<4.2, seven redshift bins) -- both abstract-verified 2026-09-23; archive: REALITY_PICTURE_01 LEVEL 0 item 8 [E]

formalism.claim: FLRW metric + Friedmann equations from GR under large-scale homogeneity/isotropy; linear cosmological perturbation theory + Boltzmann hierarchy for structure and CMB anisotropies
formalism.source: textbook-standard; perturbation apparatus: Ma & Bertschinger, ApJ 455, 7-25 (1995), astro-ph/9506072 (CDM, baryons, photons, massless+massive neutrinos; public numerical codes) -- abstract-verified 2026-09-23
formalism.caveat: linear theory valid on large scales / early times; nonlinear regime handled by N-body simulation

primitives.claim: The cosmological principle (large-scale statistical homogeneity and isotropy) is an assumption tested against data, not derived from dynamics
primitives.source: textbook-standard; consistency tested via CMB isotropy (Fixsen et al. 1996, this record) and large-scale clustering (Eisenstein et al. 2005, this record)
primitives.caveat: inflation offers a mechanism but is itself not established (see open_problems)

primitives.claim: The LCDM matter-energy content is declared, not derived: Lambda, a cold dark matter component, baryons, radiation, plus nearly scale-invariant adiabatic initial perturbations
primitives.source: Planck Collaboration, A&A 641, A6 (2020), arXiv:1807.06209 (6-parameter base LCDM) -- abstract-verified 2026-09-23; archive: RAI_STRUCTURAL_THEORY_SEARCH Answer 1 ('added CONTENT: a dark-matter field, the dimension-5 Weinberg operator, a baryogenesis mechanism')
primitives.caveat: the content/structure boundary is recorded in the archive as that account's weakest joint

derived_objects.claim: The BAO standard ruler and the CMB acoustic peak structure are derived objects: computed from pre-recombination plasma physics within linear theory given the six LCDM parameters, then observed at the predicted scale
derived_objects.source: Eisenstein et al., ApJ 633, 560 (2005) (peak 'matches predictions from recombination-epoch acoustic oscillations'); Planck Collaboration, A&A 641, A6 (2020); Ma & Bertschinger, ApJ 455, 7 (1995) -- all verified 2026-09-23 (this record)

empirical_inputs.claim: Lambda, H0, and the dark-matter fraction enter cosmology as INPUT/FITTED quantities, not derived ones
empirical_inputs.source: archive: REALITY_PICTURE_01 LEVEL 3 edge 'cosmology --INPUT--> Lambda, H0, DM fraction [T] INPUT/FITTED'

empirical_inputs.claim: The six base LCDM parameters (Omega_b h^2, Omega_c h^2, acoustic scale, A_s, n_s, tau) are REPRODUCTION-grade: fitted to data, not predicted by any theory on record
empirical_inputs.source: archive: RAI_STRUCTURAL_THEORY_SEARCH Answer 1 Section IX depth -- 'REPRODUCTION for Lambda's value, Omega_c, ... and the six LCDM numbers'; fitted values: Planck Collaboration, A&A 641, A6 (2020) (H0 = 67.4 +/- 0.5 km/s/Mpc, Omega_m = 0.315 +/- 0.007, n_s = 0.965 +/- 0.004) -- abstract-verified 2026-09-23
empirical_inputs.caveat: REPRODUCTION is the archive's depth label: the model reproduces the numbers it was fitted to; contrast the PREDICTION-grade BBN-CMB concordance in phenomena

empirical_inputs.claim: The low-entropy initial condition (the past hypothesis) is a boundary input, origin unresolved
empirical_inputs.source: archive: REALITY_PICTURE_01 LEVEL 3 edge 'arrow-of-time --REQUIRES--> boundary condition [T] INPUT (the past hypothesis) -- origin UNRESOLVED'

symmetries.claim: Primordial perturbations are consistent with statistical homogeneity and isotropy, Gaussianity, adiabaticity, and near (but not exact) scale invariance: n_s = 0.965 +/- 0.004
symmetries.source: Planck Collaboration, A&A 641, A6 (2020), arXiv:1807.06209 -- abstract-verified 2026-09-23
symmetries.caveat: consistency statements, not derivations; the mechanism producing these symmetries is not established

limits.claim: Linear perturbation theory is the controlled large-scale/early-time limit; it hands off to N-body simulation in the nonlinear regime, and the background reduces to sequential radiation-, matter-, and Lambda-dominated eras
limits.source: textbook-standard; linear apparatus per Ma & Bertschinger, ApJ 455, 7 (1995) (this record)
limits.caveat: baryonic-feedback modeling is the recorded systematic frontier of the nonlinear regime

known_connections.claim: BBN connects cosmology to laboratory nuclear physics: light-element abundances follow from measured nuclear cross-sections plus one cosmological input (the baryon-to-photon ratio)
known_connections.source: Fields, Olive, Yeh & Young, JCAP 03 (2020) 010, arXiv:1912.01132 -- abstract-verified 2026-09-23
known_connections.caveat: edge type EMPIRICAL + LIMIT_RELATION vocabulary pending Stage-3 typing; lithium remains discrepant (see phenomena caveat)

known_disconnects.claim: Vacuum energy MISMATCHES Lambda by ~120 orders of magnitude -- UNRESOLVED
known_disconnects.source: archive: REALITY_PICTURE_01 LEVEL 3 edge 'vacuum --MISMATCH--> Lambda (120 orders) [E] UNRESOLVED'; community anchor: Weinberg, Rev. Mod. Phys. 61, 1 (1989), doi:10.1103/RevModPhys.61.1 ('many orders of magnitude smaller than estimated in modern theories of elementary particles') -- abstract-verified 2026-09-23
known_disconnects.caveat: the '120 orders' figure is the naive Planck-cutoff estimate; the mismatch statement is robust to the cutoff choice

known_disconnects.claim: Literal SM+GR with SM content alone is FALSE as a cosmology source: it predicts m_nu = 0, Omega_c = 0, eta_B ~ 0, all three contradicted by measurement
known_disconnects.caveat: only the framework claim ('what is missing is content, not structure') survives, and the archive records that claim as not truth-apt as posed

known_disconnects.claim: Early-universe (CMB-calibrated) and late-universe (distance-ladder) H0 determinations disagree: 67.4 +/- 0.5 vs 73.04 +/- 1.04 km/s/Mpc, a ~5 sigma tension
known_disconnects.source: Planck Collaboration, A&A 641, A6 (2020); Riess et al., ApJL 934, L7 (2022), arXiv:2112.04510 ('a 5-sigma difference with H0 predicted by Planck+LCDM') -- both abstract-verified 2026-09-23
known_disconnects.caveat: the CMB value is model-dependent (LCDM-conditional); unresolved whether the tension is systematic or physical

known_disconnects.claim: The trace-only mu = 4/3 super-horizon growth modification is EXCLUDED (structural + ~4 sigma-class joint empirical): linear cosmology = LCDM under the chosen c0 = 0, and within the computed lensing-bound window otherwise (x < ~0.59 central-inputs, mu - 1 <= ~0.20)
known_disconnects.source: archive: NO_GO_LEDGER.md entry 2 (register mu_linear, tier derived-pending, sub_status no_go_export); legs: separate-universe consistency no-go (EdS-quantified, conditional on adiabaticity + the dilatation bridge) + ISW-cross computed ~2.0 sigma (calc/isw_exclusion.py; the old ~32 sigma retired) + DESI Sigma_0 ~3.5 sigma
known_disconnects.caveat: in-house, unreviewed; a statement about GRUT-as-written, not about nature; rests on the pure-TT projector ansatz (p_tt_ansatz, an adopted input, interrogation returned CHOSEN); empirically selected, predicts no new signature; the owed TT-auto calc likely re-tightens the window

known_disconnects.claim: A single passive relaxational mode cannot produce a phantom-divide (w = -1) crossing: the dissipative branch is one-sided (second law fixes it on the phantom side, w <= -1), so the sourced prediction is w = -1 flat, and an economical (sub-CPL) evolving w(z) matching the DESI hint is NOT EARNED
known_disconnects.source: archive: NO_GO_LEDGER.md entry 3 (register rung7_wz, rung7_w2_wa_sign, rung7_w3_nocrossing_export, all tier to-derive); community anchor: Vikman, Phys. Rev. D 71, 023515 (2005), astro-ph/0407107 (w = -1 transitions 'physically implausible' for single scalar-field dark energy) -- abstract-verified 2026-09-23
known_disconnects.caveat: in-house, unreviewed; held to-derive, conditional on the open rung3 anchor (a no-go cannot outrank its anchor); the w_a slope sign is frontier-indeterminate -- the earlier 'wrong sign' reading is RETRACTED per the 2026-06-29 rung7_w2 sign screen; the Vikman no-crossing is a reproduction of a known result, not a program discovery

open_problems.claim: Origin of the low-entropy initial condition
open_problems.source: archive: REALITY_PICTURE_01 LEVEL 6 rank 4 + LEVEL 0 not-directly-observed list; Answer 1 records SILENCE on the initial condition

open_problems.claim: The value of Lambda: why small, why nonzero, why comparable to matter density now -- input everywhere, derived nowhere
open_problems.source: archive: REALITY_PICTURE_01 LEVEL 6 rank 2 and Q16 ('unexplained by anything: ... Lambda')

open_problems.claim: The nature of dark matter: no non-gravitational detection exists; the leading direct-search results are null
open_problems.source: LZ Collaboration, Phys. Rev. Lett. 131, 041002 (2023), arXiv:2207.03764 (background-only consistent; SI WIMP-nucleon sigma > 9.2e-48 cm^2 excluded at 36 GeV/c^2, 90% CL) -- abstract-verified 2026-09-23; archive: REALITY_PICTURE_01 LEVEL 6 rank 2 (DM as input)
open_problems.caveat: null so far in the probed WIMP window; other candidate classes (axions, PBHs, ...) constrained separately, not exhausted

open_problems.claim: The mechanism of inflation is not established: primordial tensor modes are not observed, r_0.05 < 0.036 (95% CL)
open_problems.source: BICEP/Keck Collaboration, Phys. Rev. Lett. 127, 151301 (2021), arXiv:2110.00483 -- abstract-verified 2026-09-23
open_problems.caveat: the not-observed statement is first-class content; inflation's generic predictions (flatness, near scale invariance, adiabaticity, Gaussianity) are consistent with data but non-unique

observables.claim: Precision anchors: CMB TT/TE/EE + lensing spectra (Planck 2018); BAO distance ratios across 0.1 < z < 4.2 (SDSS, DESI); SN Ia distance moduli; (D/H)_P = (2.527 +/- 0.030)e-5; T_CMB = 2.72548 +/- 0.00057 K
observables.source: Planck A&A 641, A6 (2020); Eisenstein et al. ApJ 633, 560 (2005); DESI arXiv:2404.03002; Riess et al. AJ 116, 1009 (1998); Perlmutter et al. ApJ 517, 565 (1999); Cooke et al. ApJ 855, 102 (2018); Fixsen ApJ 707, 916 (2009) -- all verified 2026-09-23 (this record)

observables.claim: DESI 2024 BAO combined with CMB or SN prefers evolving dark energy (w0 > -1, wa < 0) over LCDM at 2.6 sigma (with CMB) to 3.9 sigma (adding SN)
observables.caveat: a current, dataset-dependent preference within the w0-wa parameterization, not an LCDM exclusion; unresolved

alternative_formulations.claim: Synchronous-gauge and conformal-Newtonian-gauge perturbation theory are equivalent formulations; standard Boltzmann codes implement both
Lambda as a geometric constant in the gravitational action and Lambda as constant vacuum energy density are indistinguishable at the background-cosmology level
alternative_formulations.source: Weinberg, Rev. Mod. Phys. 61, 1 (1989) -- verified 2026-09-23 (this record)
alternative_formulations.caveat: the degeneracy is what makes the mismatch in known_disconnects a problem of interpretation as well as magnitude

domain_of_validity.claim: The concordance model is directly tested from the BBN epoch (T ~ MeV, t ~ seconds) to today; the pre-BBN universe is not directly probed, the inflationary epoch is not established, and small nonlinear scales are handled by simulation with baryonic-feedback systematics
domain_of_validity.source: earliest probed epoch: Fields, Olive, Yeh & Young, JCAP 03 (2020) 010 (BBN); inflation bound: BICEP/Keck PRL 127, 151301 (2021) -- both verified 2026-09-23 (this record)
domain_of_validity.caveat: 'directly tested' means at least one observable anchored per epoch; density of tests varies enormously across the range
